# W3C N-Triples syntax tests

Copied from <https://github.com/w3c/rdf-tests> at commit
`ec2ba15e0a001431af0e56376572812fd5dd1dbc`, directory `rdf/rdf11/rdf-n-triples`:
`manifest.ttl` and every file it names as a positive or negative syntax test.
`tests.tsv` lists those files with their kind, extracted from `manifest.ttl`.

These files are covered by the W3C test suite dual license (W3C Test Suite
License and the 3-clause BSD License):
